integrity: Proof is self-contained subject to standard finite-poset chain decomposition (Dilworth). Accompanying exhaustive small-instance checkers corroborate rather than prove the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Graph factors must all be complete, with at least one binary and one nonbinary factor. Endpoint formula maximizes over shortest-path orders, not all individual orders. The already known uniform-alphabet special cases are excluded from the originality claim. Independent validation and exhaustive publication priority are not established.
title: Endpoint-conditioned rooted geodesic complexity of mixed Hamming products
